verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's CLI supports running 'hopp test' collection runs with JUnit reporting, implying test assertions can be defined and executed against requests, and pre-request scripts suggest scripting support for tests, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of writing assertions against response status/body/headers (e.g., pw.expect or test scripting API) or examples showing this capability in the UI. missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of writing assertions on response status, body, and headers within Hoppscotch's test script editor, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these assertions work as claimed.
